title: PAR-134 MTEXT background CMC flags and reserved-index retention
mode: generated AC1024/AC1032 DWG object-vector fast slice
scope: Retain R2004+ MTEXT background CMC raw flags, reserved index, and metadata presence
Preserve flagged-empty optional CMC strings through standalone and embedded MTEXT DWG paths
Refuse invalid or unsupported source metadata before output
Keep independent producer semantics and class-specific DXF extension mappings unqualified

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: R2004+ CMC has a reserved leading BS index of zero, a packed BL method/value, and an RC flags byte introducing optional color-name/book-name TV strings. MTEXT background fields use CMC; this slice preserves the generic wire provenance without claiming broader producer semantics.

localSource.finding: Standalone MTEXT retained the source method but discarded CMC flags/index. Embedded MTEXT parsing also discarded them. Replaying preserved C0/C3 values exposed a local argument mix-up between the reserved BS index and normalized color index; the writer now passes the normalized scalar while its CMC encoder emits the required zero reserved index.

productionSummary: Append MTEXT background CMC flags, reserved index, and metadata-presence fields; reset and DXF color updates clear them.
Capture method/flags/index for standalone and embedded MTEXT, including nested R2018 multiline ATTRIB/ATTDEF parsing.

Replay source flags through DWG output, including flagged-empty optional strings; validate reserved index, flag domain/string agreement, normalized color/method consistency, and detached-stream availability before writing.
changes.publicApiOrLayoutNote: Appended fields increase DRW_MText object size; downstream consumers must rebuild.

generatedControls.dwgVectors: Generated AC1024/AC1032 standalone MTEXT frames cover C0-C3, RGB black, named colors/books, flagged-empty name, and a C3-to-C5 mutation. AC1032 multiline ATTRIB/ATTDEF cases exercise embedded MTEXT with flagged-empty and named CMC strings.
generatedControls.wireWalk: Independent standalone wire walk checks reserved index, method/value, raw flags, optional strings, and the following transparency field; production parser controls verify following-handle alignment.
generatedControls.lifecycle: Copy/assignment and reset of retained MTEXT CMC metadata are asserted.
generatedControls.failClosed: Invalid RGB, non-finite scale, unsupported C5 rewrite, nonzero reserved index, unknown flags, string/flag mismatch, and missing detached stream—including flagged-empty names—are rejected before output.
